fields.summary_ko.0: Visa Inc. (V) rose +28.4% versus the financial services industry over the past year, and with strong global brand and extensive payment network, is driving growth in digital transactions and international remittances.
fields.summary_ko.1: ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. (XOM) rose +12.6% versus industry over the past 6 months, and with low production costs and integrated business model is strengthening competitiveness, though crude oil price volatility exposure remains a risk factor.
